description: Ship-system input A/B (outside variant). Bracket-tagged ship reports arrive naked at the head of operator turns. Tests both technical competence (does she reference the numeric specifics from the bracket?) and register fidelity (does she stay in ASTRA voice, no mechanism leakage). Each turn is independent (no conversation memory across turns). Companion to ship_systems_inside_think.json.
